entries.title: John 15:1
segments: "I am the vine, and my Father the vine-grower.

entries.title: John 15:2
segments: "He cuts back any of my branches that bear no fruit, and prunes every fruit-bearing branch, that it may bear more.

entries.title: John 15:3
segments: "Now you are clean through the word which I have spoken to you.

entries.title: John 15:4
segments: "Abide in me, and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit of itself except it abide in the vine, no more can you, unless you abide in me.

entries.title: John 15:5
segments: "I am the Vine you are the branches. He who abides in me and I in him, bears abundant fruit; because apart from me you can do nothing.

entries.title: John 15:6
segments: "If any one does not abide in me he is thrown away like a branch and withers. Such branches are gathered up and thrown into the fire and burned.

entries.title: John 15:7
segments: "If you abide in me and my words abide in you, ask whatever your will is, and it shall be yours.

entries.title: John 15:8
segments: "By this is my Father glorified, by your bearing abundant fruit, and so being my disciples.

entries.title: John 15:9
segments: "As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you; abide in my love.

entries.title: John 15:10
segments: "If you obey my commands you will abide in my love, just as I have obeyed my Father's commands and abide in his love.

entries.title: John 15:11
segments: "I have told you these things that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

entries.title: John 15:12
segments: "This is my command, Love one another as I have loved you.

entries.title: John 15:13
segments: "Greater love has no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

entries.title: John 15:14
segments: "You are my friends if you do what I command you.

entries.title: John 15:15
segments: "I no longer call you slaves, because a slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I have learned from my Father.

entries.title: John 15:16
segments: "You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; so that whatever you ask the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

entries.title: John 15:17
segments: "This is my command: to love one another. If the worlds hates you,

entries.title: John 15:18
segments: "do not forget that it hated me first.

entries.title: John 15:19
segments: "If you belonged to the world, the world would love its own; but because you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, for that reason the world hates you.

entries.title: John 15:20
segments: "Remember what I told you, `A slave is not better than his master.' If they persecuted me, they will persecute you. If they have obeyed my word, they will obey yours also.

entries.title: John 15:21
segments: "But they will do all these things to you for my name's sake, because they know not Him who sent me.

entries.title: John 15:22
segments: "If I had not come and spoken to them, they would have no sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

entries.title: John 15:23
segments: "He who hates me hates my Father also.

entries.title: John 15:24
segments: "If I had not done among them such works as none ever did, they would have had no sin; but now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father.

entries.title: John 15:25
segments: "And so is fulfilled the word written in their Law, `They hate me without cause.'

entries.title: John 15:26
segments: "When the Comforter is come whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of Truth who comes forth from the Father, he will bear witness of me;

entries.title: John 15:27
segments: "and you to shall bear witness because you have been with me from the first.
